events.title: 2,000 Wishlists & Steam Next Fest! 🎉
events.summary: We've reached 2,000 wishlists on Steam! 🥹💛Thank you to everyone who has supported Tiny Dwellings! We're so happy to see all the love for our little cosy game! 🏡And there's more exciting news...Tiny Dwellings is joining Steam Next Fest! 🎉If you haven't tried our FREE demo yet, now's the perfect time to jump in and start building and decorating your own cosy little spaces!We can't wait to see what you create! 🫶

events.title: 🏡 Tiny Dwellings Demo is OUT NOW!

events.title: Welcome to Tiny Dwellings 🏡
events.summary: Welcome to Tiny Dwellings 🏡Tiny Dwellings is for anyone who loves arranging furniture, placing plants, adding lights, and spending way too long making one tiny corner feel just right.There’s no rush and no pressure, just a quiet creative sandbox where you can build cosy rooms, decorate little homes, create gardens, and fill each space with details that feel personal.The game grew out of our love for cosy spaces, decoration, and expressive home-building.
